judgments.reason: Onton (2009) analyzes EEG from the eyes-closed emotion imagination task, matching the Imagined Emotion Study (Onton & Makeig) data, so it is the study paper reporting this data.
judgments.paper_title: High-frequency broadband modulation of electroencephalographic spectra

judgments.reason: Kothe et al. is a machine-learning analysis of a 12-subject guided emotion imagery EEG set from the same lab. It doesn't introduce or release this dataset, so it isn't a data descriptor.
judgments.paper_title: Emotion Recognition from EEG during Self-Paced Emotional Imagery

judgments.reason: Hsu et al. 2022 applies AMICA to this emotion-imagination EEG data, but it is an analysis study, not the dataset's data descriptor. Ambiguous, so related_work.
judgments.paper_title: Unsupervised learning of brain state dynamics during emotion imagination using high-density EEG
